chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Hashim ibn al-Muthanna said:

I was sitting with Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) when a man entered and asked him about a man who has sexual relations with a woman unlawfully (zina), whether he may marry her. He said: Yes, and [also] her mother and her daughter.
ai.seo_question: Can a man who commits zina with a woman marry her or her mother/daughter?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that zina does not create a permanent impediment to marriage, affirming that a man may marry the woman he had illicit relations with, as well as her mother and daughter. This ruling highlights the distinction between the act of zina and the legal bonds of kinship, a key topic in Shia fiqh for determining marital eligibility. The permissibility extends to the mother and daughter, indicating that the zina does not prohibit marriage to other female relatives in the same lineage.
